items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: Thursday I’m off to Minneapolis to play four days with a friend of mine, Steve Pikal

ctx.x: Right. What’s your very next gig, speaking of gigs?

I’m playing Saturday, there’s a place in Brighton, Michigan called — it’s an Italian place called Ciao Amici’s. And we’re going to be doing two shows Saturday night, and that will be the full thing, you know, the jazz, the rock, the craziness. And then Monday I’ve got a private event duo performance with my piano player. Tuesday I’m guesting with the Mott Community College big band. Wednesday I’m playing at the Zehnder’s Frankenmuth Ragtime Festival and then Thursday I’m off to Minneapolis to play four days with…
Write some songs and work on the Mozart Clarinet Concerto.
